data.one_liner: WebRTC plugin for real-time audio, video and data communication.
data.what_it_does: Provides WebRTC APIs for Flutter applications across mobile, desktop, and web platforms. Enables peer-to-peer audio/video streaming, data channels, and screen capture using native GoogleWebRTC bindings.
use_when: Building real-time video calling or audio conferencing applications
Implementing peer-to-peer data channels for multiplayer games or file sharing
Sharing screen contents across mobile and desktop platforms
avoid_when: You only need simple media playback from URLs without peer-to-peer streaming
You want a fully managed video backend without setting up signaling servers
strengths: Cross-platform support including iOS, Android, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux
Comprehensive WebRTC feature set including Unified-Plan, Simulcast, and Data Channels
Actively maintained with regular updates to the underlying libwebrtc SDK
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of native permissions and build settings
Complex API surface inherent to the WebRTC specification
data.setup_notes: Requires adding camera and microphone permissions in iOS Info.plist and Android Manifest, setting up Java 8 / minimum SDK version for Android, and configuring CocoaPods or Swift Package Manager.
